subject: tape measure
description: A retractable steel tape in a case, with a spring return, a hooked end and a lock button.
prompt: Give five unusual but workable uses for an ordinary retractable tape measure at a community repair cafe, beyond measuring length. For each idea, explain which property makes it work and how a person would use it. Small ordinary additions are allowed. Develop different functions rather than five versions of one function.
quality_constraints: Ordinary small additions only; no powered electronics
Each proposal has an interpretable physical connection

subject: cracked teacup
description: A porcelain teacup with a fine crack that still holds tea.
prompt: Invent five distinct short-story premises in which a cracked teacup changes how a character keeps a promise. Give each premise a consistent rule, a character choice, and a consequence. Make the premises genuinely different, not five versions of one plot.
quality_constraints: A character choice and its consequence
